<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Consulta de Disponibilidade">eff4514b83e7cf503d22a8d0deaad358</macroponent><name>rich_text_1/now_default/html</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function evaluateProperty({api}) {

    const data = api.state.selected_date;
    const horario = api.state.selected_time;
    const participantes = api.state.participants_count;

    if (!data && !horario && !participantes) {
        return 'Selecione data, horário e quantidade de participantes para consultar as salas.';
    }

    let dataFormatada = data || '—';

    if (data) {
        const somenteData = data.substring(0, 10);
        const partes = somenteData.split('-');

        if (partes.length === 3) {
            dataFormatada =
                partes[2] + '/' +
                partes[1] + '/' +
                partes[0];
        }
    }

    return 'Salas disponíveis para ' +
        (participantes || '—') +
        ' participantes • ' +
        dataFormatada +
        ' às ' +
        (horario || '—');
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-07 01:55:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>d36bec1d833343d03d22a8d0deaad35e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>rich_text_1/now_default/html</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Gestao de Espacos" source="x_1026684_gestao_0">c869e29a83638b503d22a8d0deaad38c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Gestao de Espacos">c869e29a83638b503d22a8d0deaad38c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_d36bec1d833343d03d22a8d0deaad35e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-07 01:55:43</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
